purpose: Freeze conservative cost, execution-observability, capital, margin and opportunity-cost rules before any lab economic outcome is evaluated.

G06_FEES.application_rule: Charge the frozen one-way taker rate on each venue for every entry, exit and trading rebalance in the mechanism-replication baseline. These constants are conservative research charges, not assertions that they exactly equal every historical fee regime.
G06_FEES.historical_exactness_rule: A claim of historically executable net return requires dated authoritative fee provenance. If exact historical base fees cannot be dated, executable-return claims remain blocked even when the conservative mechanism replication is run.
G06_FEES.maker_policy: Maker is diagnostic sensitivity only after a separately frozen queue/fill model from audit-grade data. No guaranteed maker fills.

G07_EXECUTION_DATA.reason: Symmetric audit-grade historical execution data across both venues have not been proven. Hyperliquid states its historical archive can be missing and not timely; Binance public historical book data have documented coverage/sampling limitations. No favorable fill imputation is allowed.
G07_EXECUTION_DATA.path_to_executable_validation: Prospective synchronized L2/trade collector on both venues with deterministic fill/slippage rules frozen before outcomes.

G08_MARGIN_CAPITAL.liquidation_policy: Venue-level liquidation/forced deleveraging terminates that path under the frozen loss convention. Profit at the other venue cannot retroactively prevent liquidation.
G08_MARGIN_CAPITAL.exact_historical_liquidation_claim_rule: Requires authoritative date-matched margin tiers and liquidation rules. Without them, only conservative capital-sufficiency and stress diagnostics are allowed; no claim of exact historical liquidatability.
G08_MARGIN_CAPITAL.hyperliquid_formula_reference: maintenance_margin = notional_position_value * maintenance_margin_rate - maintenance_deduction; maintenance rate depends on margin tier; current docs state maintenance margin is half the initial margin at maximum leverage.

G09_OPPORTUNITY_COST.benchmark_name: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 3-Month Constant Maturity, Quoted on an Investment Basis
G09_OPPORTUNITY_COST.timestamp_rule: At each accrual timestamp use only the latest DGS3MO observation whose publication/availability timestamp is not after the accrual timestamp. Never backfill from a future observation.
G09_OPPORTUNITY_COST.non_business_day_rule: Carry forward only the latest previously available observation; no interpolation from future data.

G10_REPLICATION_PARTITION_POLICY.window_selection: Earliest through latest common full UTC months passing provenance for all four funding series. Selection uses timestamps/coverage only and may not inspect funding magnitude, carry, APR, PnL or asset ranking.

scientific_boundary: This freeze does not establish edge, authorize economic Discovery, authorize paper/live trading, or permit an executable-return claim. G03/G04 provenance and deterministic window materialization remain required before Discovery authorization can be considered.
